headlines.text: Flash back to 2020, when the AEW TNT Title had a new owner by the end of the night as Cody vs. Brodie Lee battled it out, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.53 ? an outstanding performance from both sides ? ending the champion's reign at 3 defenses. A brutal, bloody dog collar rematch on Jericho's 30th-anniversary special ? Lee busted Cody open early with the chain, but Cody fought back to reclaim the TNT Title he'd lost so shockingly weeks earlier.

On this day in 2025, Mercedes Mone vs. Lacey Lane went to battle over the AEW TBS Title, appearing on Dynamite, rated 5.80. Lacey Lane was challenging for gold for the very first time. This stood as the 60th match in AEW TBS Title history ? a genuinely rare milestone for that title. In an open challenge that saw the champion's collection put on the line against a hungry newcomer, Mon? retained the TBS Championship over Lacey Lane.

It was 2022 when the AEW World Trios Titles was up for grabs as Death Triangle vs. Dark Order (Reynolds & Silver) & Ten went to war, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.78. It was the first title opportunity of Dark Order (Reynolds & Silver) & Ten's career. Championship gold always raises the stakes.

secondaries.text: It was 2023 when Eddie Kingston vs. Komander went to battle over the ROH World Heavyweight Title, appearing on Collision, rated 6.55.

Back on this day in 2020, the inaugural FTW Title was crowned as Brian Cage vs. Will Hobbs went to war, appearing on Dynamite, rated 6.93. The very first defense of the FTW Championship in AEW's history ? two of the promotion's biggest powerhouses colliding on the same stacked night as Cody's dog collar rematch.
Back on this day in 2022, PAC vs. Trent Beretta clashed for the AEW All-Atlantic Title, appearing on Battle of the Belts, rated 7.46 ? a strong outing.
